Class AppTester<T>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.testing.AppTester<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the application class
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class AppTester<T> extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Runs an application in a test: the real lifecycle, headless, with fakes for the platform, the directories, the clock and the dialogs. 
try (AppTester<CounterApp> app = AppTester.start(CounterApp.class, Locale.FRENCH)) {
    app.commands(CounterAppCommands.class).increment().execute();

    assertThat(app.component(JLabel.class).getText()).isEqualTo("Le compte est : 1.");
}

Frames and dialogs are never realized: each window is a bare root pane, where the content, menu bar and toolbar are built and laid out. Every call on the tester, and on the commands it returns, runs on the EDT and waits; before returning, the tester runs the updates posted by observables and the periodic actions whose period has elapsed on the FakeTicker, once each, and waits for the tasks commands start and for the @OnVirtualThread deliveries of the application's bus, but not for the other tasks an application starts, so assertions see the components as the user will. A component repainted or invalidated off the EDT, a failure no handler handles, and duplicate mnemonics or shortcuts, in a dialog or in a menu the framework rebuilt after a dynamic section changed, fail the test at the tester's next call.

The platform is gaia's FakePlatform for Linux, with its directories on a gaia-memfs file system, so window state and settings are saved in memory. Every call also waits for the pending settings saves, and close() waits up to 2 seconds for them. Time is a FakeTicker and an InstantSource fixed at the epoch.

In a multi-frame application, which has no main window, the methods that act on the main window act on the active frame, and bean(Class) resolves through its view's injector. frames() and frame(Class) reach every open frame.

The tester keeps the ValidationFeedback of the modules on its path, so tests check a form's errors as the user sees them: through the tool tip text and accessible description of the component.

    • activate

      public void activate(BoundCommand command)
      Activates a command on the EDT, as a click would, and runs the posted updates, but doesn't wait for the task it starts, so that a test can act while the task runs, such as activating it again or checking a stop command. Tests hold such tasks with latches: the tester's other calls wait for them. It waits for the @OnVirtualThread deliveries and the pending settings saves, as every other call does.
      Parameters:
      command - the command
